description: n + 1 with both operands known integers lowers to a direct call of Kernel.+ whose result is delivered to a resume entry: the caller is split in two, the rest of the body's live values are captured in a closure, and fz_op_add_ii runs behind deliver_lanes. Seen in the backend dump of walk(<<c, r :: binary>>, n) -> walk(r, n + 1): 'tail direct_call +(v1, 1) -> deliver e1', e1 captures r. About 26% of the plain walk after inline reads; about 4 fz_closure_get_capture_ref and 2 fz_closure_code_ref calls per step. Not checked in release. Needs investigation (why the operator is not folded into its caller; what else is in the same position: comparisons, rem, byte_size) and a proposal page before building. Evidence: scratchpad b183-5/walkd.backend, walkd.clif.
title: Arithmetic on known integers does not go through a continuation
